Daniel wanted to improve his physical strength and overall fitness but struggled with consistency and a lack of structured guidance. His daily routine involved minimal physical activity, and he often felt low on energy and motivation.

He approached us with the goal of building strength, increasing stamina, and developing a sustainable fitness routine that fits his lifestyle.

Project Challenges

Identifying key obstacles

Throughout the initial stages, the client struggled with maintaining consistency, lacked a clear workout structure, and experienced low energy levels. These challenges highlighted the need for a personalized approach that focused on building sustainable routines and improving overall strength gradually.
